query:
SELECT substr(COALESCE(purchased_on, created_at), 1, 7) AS "period!: String",
                  COUNT(*) AS "copies!: i64"
           FROM copies
           WHERE status = 'owned' AND bundle_id IS NULL
             AND COALESCE(purchased_on, created_at) >= date('now', 'start of month', '-11 months')
           GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
